title: OntologyPackModule
description: One independently selectable module in an ontology library pack.

id.description: Stable module key within the pack.

resourcePath.description: Classpath resource used for redistributable bundled modules.

sourceUrl.description: Authoritative external source: where a catalogue-only module is obtained, or where a bundled module was published.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact bundled payload.

sourceSha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the published file, recorded only when the generator converted it to the bundled Turtle payload.

conceptCount.description: Distinct IRIs typed owl:Class, rdfs:Class or skos:Concept in the payload.

relationshipCount.description: Distinct IRI-to-IRI rdfs:subClassOf, rdfs:subPropertyOf, skos:broader, skos:narrower and skos:related statements in the payload.
